aboutGame.title: What is Something is Wrong With My Dog?
paragraphs: Something is Wrong With My Dog is a Roblox horror survival mystery developed by the group DELTA and inspired by LookOut2DD's original series. You enter Bob's woods, meet a grey wolf named Jerry, offer him bones, build a camp, and return each night to compare what changed in the forest.

The Roblox experience pairs a story mode built around Jerry, Bob, and 10 endings with a Survival Mode that keeps the same map but drops the narrative layer. Solo play supports careful exploration, while co-op sessions for up to eight players let groups divide scouting, camp work, and clue tracking.

modules.name: Something is Wrong With My Dog Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start with the controls, tame Jerry at the treeline, gather early resources, and build a camp before your first night in Bob's woods.

highlights.detail: Spawn in Bob's woods and learn WASD for movement, E for inventory, and M for the map.
Collect three bones from exploration, mining, or world spawns before approaching Jerry.
Equip the bones with E and offer them to Jerry at the treeline with Right Click.
Build a camp and scout only nearby landmarks before the light starts to fade.
Return before nightfall, then check what Jerry left behind the next morning.

modules.name: Something is Wrong With My Dog All Endings Guide
modules.description: Plan a complete ending run by tracking Jerry, Bob, the cabin, the grave, and the log, then compare how each choice changes the finale.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: True ending — complete optional discoveries before the point of no return and watch the full finale.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Secret ending — sweep every area, re-check objects after story beats, and choose direct dialogue.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Good ending — follow the full story route and keep Jerry close through each night.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Bad ending — rushing past clues and accepting the first explanation closes the shortest path.

modules.name: Something is Wrong With My Dog Jerry Taming Guide
modules.description: Find Jerry, gather exactly three bones, and complete the taming sequence that unlocks the Good Boy badge.

highlights.detail: Look for the thin grey wolf with a red collar at the edge of the woods.
Check your inventory and gather exactly three bones.
Press E, select the bones, and walk up to Jerry.
Use Right Click to offer each bone until all three are consumed.
Confirm the Good Boy badge and keep Jerry close during the run.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Something is Wrong With My Dog.

items.question: What is Something is Wrong With My Dog?
items.answer: Something is Wrong With My Dog is a Roblox horror survival mystery inspired by LookOut2DD's series. You explore Bob's woods with Jerry, build a camp, survive each night, and investigate the clues that change the story's ending.

items.question: Is Something is Wrong With My Dog available on Roblox?
items.answer: Yes. Something is Wrong With My Dog is played through its Roblox experience, where you can enter solo or join a co-op session with friends.

items.question: How many endings does Something is Wrong With My Dog have?
items.answer: Something is Wrong With My Dog has 10 endings. Story choices, optional discoveries, and the clues you follow across multiple runs determine which finale you reach.

items.question: How do you tame Jerry in Something is Wrong With My Dog?
items.answer: In Something is Wrong With My Dog, gather exactly three bones, open your inventory with E, and use Right Click to offer each bone to Jerry at the treeline. The Good Boy badge confirms the bond.

items.question: Can you play Something is Wrong With My Dog solo or in co-op?
items.answer: Something is Wrong With My Dog supports solo play and co-op sessions for up to eight players. Solo runs suit careful exploration, while co-op lets players split camp work, scouting, and clue tracking.
